correctness.rationale: PASS: Complete frozen result defines p=|U|, q=|D|, m=p+q and arc alternating matching vertices with k +1 entries on U and k -1 on D, zero elsewhere. Direct expansion of squared distance from c_i=q/m on U, -p/m on D gives exactly pq/m regardless of k. The general projection lemma is valid for ANY finite equal-radius vertices: projection y of c onto P yields squared maximum distance R0²-|c-y|² by the normal cone inequality; exposed-face convex coefficients of y give matching lower bound for every other center and uniqueness. Every prefix of c is (q u_j-p d_j)/m. The complete source sign/rise/fall facet system then gives c in P iff each prefix belongs to [0,1]; boundary p,q>=1 and monotone word U^pD^q criterion pq<=p+q follow. Translating by 1_D yields active 0/1 base vertices of rank q and c+1_D=(q/m)1; apply published matroid uniform-density characterization after excluding ambient loops. Independently checked 255 U/D words of length 2–9 via exact Fraction cosphericity and LP hull-membership; the 57 balanced cases match the prefix condition. The finite check is corroboration, not the universal proof.
